name: Rover Path Planner
description: An interactive 3D lunar rover dropped onto unmapped terrain. It maps the ground from a stereo camera point cloud, feels slopes with an IMU, plans with A* in a Web Worker, keeps its wheels out of no-go zones and backs out of trouble. Below it, an x-ray model shows the avionics and wiring inside.

name: Nexus Odds
description: A sports betting analytics SaaS with 2,600+ registered users and 1,290+ lifetime paying customers. I designed the original Python data-collection framework and serverless AWS ingestion pipeline; the platform now processes ~32M odds records a day across 33+ sportsbooks and prediction markets.

name: Personal Website
description: This site: Astro, React and Tailwind CSS on Netlify. The résumé PDF is generated from HTML, project screenshots refresh themselves every week, and CI lints, tests and builds every change.
